title: A fresh executor can implement and prove a planned slice without hidden context

task.prompt: Plan one independently deployable vertical slice, then give only its `.scratch/<feat>/FEATURE.md` and repo snapshot to a fresh executor using the same model and budget.
task.fixture: isolated typed web-service repo with one public API seam and existing tests

requirements.criterion: The cold executor completes every AC through the unit's named public seam and produces replayable command, exit/tally, and artifact evidence.
The final diff contains no behavior outside the units' declared touches/test_paths write set.

graders.procedure: Run the artifact gate, require every unit in FEATURE.md to be done, then run every 共享验证 command (including the full suite) from its cwd; any non-zero exit fails.
graders.command: python3 "$EVAL_COSMOS_ROOT/workflow/verify-artifacts.py" . && python3 -c "import glob,json,re,subprocess,sys;F=open(glob.glob('.scratch/*/FEATURE.md')[0],encoding='utf-8').read();j=json.loads(re.search(r'\x60{3}json\n(.*?)\n\x60{3}',F,re.S).group(1));st=re.findall(r'^- status: *(\w+)',F,re.M);sys.exit(not st or any(s!='done' for s in st) or any(subprocess.call(c,shell=True,cwd=j['cwd']) for c in j['commands'].values()))"

graders.procedure: List files changed since eval-base (tracked and untracked); every file outside .scratch/ must equal or sit under a FEATURE.md unit's touches or test_paths entry.
graders.command: python3 -c "import glob,re,subprocess,sys;F=open(glob.glob('.scratch/*/FEATURE.md')[0],encoding='utf-8').read();o=[p.rstrip('/') for m in re.findall(r'^- (?:touches|test_paths): *(.+)',F,re.M) for p in re.split(r'[ ,]+',m.split('#')[0].strip()) if p];bad=[f for f in subprocess.run('git diff --name-only eval-base; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard',shell=True,capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.split() if not f.startswith('.scratch/') and not any(f==p or f.startswith(p+'/') for p in o)];print(bad);sys.exit(bool(bad))"
